name: Taj Mahal
description: A white-marble mausoleum set in Mughal gardens beside the Yamuna.

name: Qutb Minar
description: A soaring brick minaret anchors a complex of early Indo-Islamic ruins.

name: Red Fort
description: Mughal sandstone walls enclose palaces on Old Delhi’s eastern edge.

name: Amber Fort
description: A hillside fort-palace of courtyards and mirrored halls above Maota Lake.

name: Gateway of India
description: A basalt arch on Mumbai’s waterfront facing the harbour.

name: Varanasi ghats
description: Stone steps line the Ganges for rituals, boats and dawn light.

name: Kerala backwaters
description: Canals and lagoons crossed by houseboats in southern Kerala.

name: Baga–Calangute stretch
description: Popular Arabian Sea beaches with shacks and water sports in North Goa.

name: Hampi
description: Boulder landscapes and Vijayanagara temple ruins across the Tungabhadra.

name: Pangong Lake
description: A high-altitude lake of shifting blues on the Changthang plateau.

name: Chandni Chowk food lanes
description: Old Delhi lanes of chaat, paratha and sweets near the Red Fort.

name: Crawford Market
description: A historic market hall for produce and household goods in South Mumbai.

name: Mandai Market
description: Pune’s central produce market near Shaniwar Wada.

name: KR Market
description: A sprawling wholesale flower and produce market in Bengaluru.

name: New Market
description: A colonial-era market complex for food, clothes and household goods.

name: Diwali
description: Festival of lights with lamps, sweets and fireworks across Indian cities.
